slides.texte_overlay:
small ways to clear
your mental clutter

writing before deciding

before any big decision, write down what you actually want and why. putting thoughts on paper untangles them faster than endlessly circling in your head.

feeding your brain well

a few calm minutes of learning each day gives your mind fresh ideas and sharper connections. new knowledge gives you new angles on old, stubborn problems.
slides.texte_sophia:
feeding your brain well

my thoughts used to feel tangled. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, history or science, and new ideas help me see problems far more clearly.

slides.texte_overlay:
walking it out

when you're stuck, go for a short walk without your phone. moving your body changes how your brain works, and answers often appear halfway around the block.

one tab at a time

close every browser tab and screen you don't need right now. a cluttered screen creates a cluttered mind, and single tasking makes your thinking so much sharper.

sleeping on it

for important choices, wait one night before deciding. your brain keeps sorting the problem while you sleep, and morning answers are often far wiser and calmer.
